name: When should I start planning appliance layout during a kitchen remodel?

mainEntity.name: When should I start planning appliance layout during a kitchen remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Appliance layout planning should begin during the initial design phase of your kitchen remodel. Appliance dimensions and utility requirements (electrical, plumbing, gas lines) directly impact cabinet design, counter space, and wall modifications. Early decisions prevent costly changes later in the project. Consult with your general contractor and kitchen designer to integrate appliance choices seamlessly into the overall layout before construction starts. This ensures all necessary infrastructure is roughed in correctly from the outset.
acceptedAnswer.description: Start planning appliance layout in the initial kitchen design phase, as appliance dimensions and utility needs affect cabinet design and construction early on.
